name: phase-card
title: phase-card
description: One stage of a process: its name, an optional duration above it, and one line on what happens. A raised card on the page. Owns its full style, references tokens only.

definition.name: phase-card
definition.description: One stage of a process: its name, an optional duration above it, and one line on what happens. A raised card on the page. Owns its full style, references tokens only.
definition.whenToUse: A single stage in a sequence someone moves through, such as a phase of a project, a step of onboarding or a stage of a programme. Compose several in a row, one Ref each, mapping title, duration and body to host fields. For work plotted against weeks, use a timeline instead.

duration.description: How long the stage lasts, as stated, such as '6 weeks' or 'Ongoing'. Empty when the stage has no fixed length.

title.description: The stage's name, in two or three words.

body.description: What happens in this stage, in one short sentence.
body.default: Understand the goals and choose where to start.
